summaries.economy: Inflation hit 3.8% in April and may reach 6% in Q2. Bond yields surged to multiyear highs across global markets. Traders now price in a Fed rate hike by early 2027.
summaries.economy_long: Inflation accelerated to 3.8% annually in April, with professional forecasters projecting 6% by Q2. The Strait of Hormuz closure has pushed Brent crude above $111, driving Treasury yields to multiyear highs and pricing out Fed rate cuts. Watch the FOMC meeting minutes and flash US PMI data for the Fed's next policy signal.
summaries.industries: Small-bay industrial vacancy remains below 5% nationally. Amazon's 30-minute delivery expansion deepens demand for last-mile nodes. Freight layoffs and supply chain disruptions are reshaping logistics operations across the country.
summaries.industries_long: Small-bay industrial vacancy sits below 5%; freight layoffs and logistics restructuring are accelerating. Amazon's 30-minute delivery rollout and project44's AI Autopilot are reshaping last-mile and supply chain operations. Watch Blackstone's $25 billion data center acquisition pipeline and the proposed NextEra-Dominion merger for infrastructure signals.
summaries.logistics: Supply chains face severe fuel cost pressure from the Hormuz closure. Spot freight rates are approaching all-time highs and trucking capacity is tightening. Companies are racing to build inventory, driving near-term warehouse demand.
summaries.logistics_long: Freight costs are spiking, capacity is tightening, and inventory stockpiling is accelerating across global supply chains. The Strait of Hormuz closure has pushed diesel to $5.64 per gallon and spot rates near all-time highs. The IEA warns undersupply may persist through October, regardless of conflict resolution.
summaries.policy: Trade policy is active, with tariff refunds now reaching major importers. Customs enforcement is intensifying following a landmark $549M fraud settlement. The U.S.-China trade truce holds, but key terms expire in November.
summaries.policy_long: Trade policy is in active flux, with tariff enforcement, refunds, and new trade frameworks reshaping import conditions simultaneously. Federal customs enforcement is intensifying — the Perfectus settlement and CBP refund processing signal aggressive bidirectional scrutiny. Watch the Trump decision on quartz tariffs and the November expiration of the U.S.-China trade truce.
